Job Description: 
 • Experience in Infosphere suite (Information Analyzer (IA), Business Glossary (BG), Metadata Workbench (Data Lineage) tools)
 • Technically sound candidate that can Coordinate with Infrastructure support groups during the build out of the new servers and software install setup.
 • Experience with any of the foundational tools and has the technical competence to work with them, exporting and importing, writing scripts, etc.
 • Experience with Informatica to bring in Informatica code into the data lineage tools,
 • Working knowledge of Informatica repository
 • Excellent communication skills


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6 months 
 INTERVIEW: PHONE & SKYPE
